statutory_framework.mva_definition_section: Section 2(28), Motor Vehicles Act, 1988 (Definition of 'Motor Vehicle')
statutory_framework.exemption_status: Excluded from statutory definition of Motor Vehicle if conditions in Rule 2(u) are met

statutory_advisory: Vehicles satisfying CMVR Rule 2(u) (<= 250W power and <= 25 km/h cut-off speed) are classified as non-motorised cycles/carriages under law. Traffic police cannot demand Driving Licence, Registration Certificate, or levy MVA helmet fines under Section 194D.
